Name: SNOMEDCTBodyStructures
Title: SNOMED CT Body Structures
Description: This value set includes all codes from [SNOMED CT](http://snomed.info/sct) where concept is-a 442083009 (Anatomical or acquired body site (body structure)).

Name: Identifier Type Codes
Title: IdentifierType
Description: A coded type for an identifier that can be used to determine which identifier to use for a specific purpose.

Name: IdentifierUse
Title: IdentifierUse
Description: Identifies the purpose for this identifier, if known .

Name: CommonLanguages
Title: Common Languages
Description: This value set includes common codes from BCP-47 (http://tools.ietf.org/html/bcp47)

Name: SNOMEDCTMedicationAsNeededReasonCodes
Title: SNOMED CT Medication As Needed Reason Codes
Description: This value set includes all clinical findings from SNOMED CT - provided as an exemplar value set.

Name: ParticipantRoles
Title: Participant Roles
Description: Roles of participants that may be included in a care team.  Defined as: Is a Person, Healthcare professional (occupation) or Healthcare related organization (qualifier value).

Name: ProcedurePerformerRoleCodes
Title: Procedure Performer Role Codes
Description: This example value set defines the set of codes that can be used to indicate a role of a procedure performer.

Name: ProcedureCodes(SNOMEDCT)
Title: Procedure Codes (SNOMED CT)
Description: Procedure Code: All SNOMED CT procedure codes.

Name: ProcedureReasonCodes
Title: Procedure Reason Codes
Description: This example value set defines the set of codes that can be used to indicate a reason for a procedure.

Name: RequestIntent
Title: RequestIntent
Description: Codes indicating the degree of authority/intentionality associated with a request.

Name: RequestPriority
Title: Request priority
Description: The clinical priority of a diagnostic order.

Name: RequestStatus
Title: RequestStatus
Description: Codes identifying the lifecycle stage of a request.

Name: ResourceType
Title: ResourceType
Description: One of the resource types defined as part of this version of FHIR.

Name: ServiceRequestCategoryCodes
Title: Service Request Category Codes
Description: An example value set of SNOMED CT concepts that can classify a requested service

Name: ServiceRequestOrderDetailsCodes
Title: Service Request Order Details Codes
Description: An example value set of Codified order entry details concepts.  These concepts only make sense in the context of what is being ordered.  This example is for a patient ventilation order

Name: SubscriptionChannelType
Title: SubscriptionChannelType
Description: The type of method used to execute a subscription.

Name: SubscriptionStatus
Title: SubscriptionStatus
Description: The status of a subscription.

Name: TaskCode
Title: Task Codes
Description: Codes indicating the type of action that is expected to be performed

Name: TaskIntent
Title: TaskIntent
Description: Distinguishes whether the task is a proposal, plan or full order.

Name: TaskStatus
Title: TaskStatus
Description: The current status of the task.

Name: BackportContentValueSet
Title: Backported R5 Subscription Content Value Set
Description: Codes to represent how much resource content to send in the notification payload.

Name: ServiceDeliveryLocationRoleType
Title: ServiceDeliveryLocationRoleType
Description: A role of a place that further classifies the setting (e.g., accident site, road side, work site, community location) in which services are delivered.

Name: TwiinNotificationFormats
Title: Twiin Notification Formats
Description: MIME types permitted in Subscription.channel.payload under TA Notifications: application/fhir+json and application/fhir+xml.

Name: TAWorkflowBusinessStatusVS
Title: TA Workflow Business Status
Description: Codes for Task.businessStatus of the Coordination Task under TA Workflow (TA sections Business status; Codes of this TA). Extensible: a use case MAY define further codes. selected is reserved for the Placer.

Name: TAWorkflowStatusReasonVS
Title: TA Workflow Status Reason
Description: Codes for Task.statusReason of the Coordination Task under TA Workflow. Extensible: a use case or a Fulfiller MAY use other reasons, for instance when it rejects a Task; not-selected is reserved for the Placer.

Name: TAWorkflowTaskCodeVS
Title: TA Workflow Task Code
Description: Codes for Task.code of the Coordination Task under TA Workflow.
